title: Valuation + independent re-derivation
description: Derive the value twice — appraiser reasoning against a declared valuation model run — and gate the reported value on the two agreeing within tolerance.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: wf-rec-01
  title: Valuation + independent re-derivation
  description: Derive the value twice — appraiser reasoning against a declared valuation model run — and
    gate the reported value on the two agreeing within tolerance.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Report a property value that was independently re-derived, with the sensitivity drivers named
    and any divergence between the two derivations explained.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n-approval
  nodes:
    - id: n-intake
      kind: input
      name: Property, comparable, and income evidence
      summary: Property, comparable, and income evidence
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - text
        properties:
          text:
            type: string
            description: The requester's objective, source material, or instructions.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - subject_property
              - comparable_sales
              - income_and_expense
              - valuation_date
            properties:
              subject_property: {}
              comparable_sales: {}
              income_and_expense: {}
              valuation_date: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: n-select
      kind: transform
      name: Select figures under test
      summary: select the comparables, income inputs, and valuation date under review
      config:
        operation: select
        expression: select the comparables, income inputs, and valuation date under review
    - id: n-derive
      kind: agent
      templateRef: rec-01
      name: Appraiser reconciliation of approaches
      summary: First derivation, from the specification.
      role: Valuation analyst reconciling comparable, income, and cost approaches.
      prompt: You are a Property Valuation Analyst. You develop value under the approaches the property
        actually supports, adjust comparables with the reasoning for each adjustment stated, and reconcile
        the approaches to a conclusion rather than averaging them. You name the assumptions the value
        is most sensitive to — cap rate, absorption, adjustment scale — because a single-point value hides
        where the risk is.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - finance-analysis
          - domain-analysis
          - simulation
          - decision-analysis
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:property-data
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-recompute
      kind: tool
      name: Valuation model run
      summary: Host-supplied automated valuation and discounted cash flow calculation. Declared as a requirement;
        Ladder Graph does not execute it.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - finance-analysis
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - calculate
          - mcp:property-data
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-agree
      kind: aggregator
      name: Compare the two derivations
      summary: Tally the two independently derived values; a tie is a discrepancy, not an average.
      config:
        aggregation: vote
    - id: n-discrepancy
      kind: condition
      name: Within tolerance?
      summary: Route on abs(appraised_value - model_value) / model_value <= 0.10.
      config:
        expression: abs(appraised_value - model_value) / model_value <= 0.10
        branches:
          - label: Agreed
            when: agreed
          - label: Discrepant
            when: discrepant
    - id: n-reconcile
      kind: agent
      templateRef: rec-06
      name: Explain the valuation divergence
      summary: Explain the discrepancy before anything downstream consumes the number.
      role: Performance analyst assessing energy, envelope, and comfort outcomes against design intent.
      prompt: You are a Building Performance Analyst. You compare measured performance against design
        intent and model predictions, and you attribute the gap to envelope, systems, controls, or occupancy
        rather than reporting a single performance shortfall. You state which measurements would distinguish
        the remaining hypotheses, because a performance gap without a diagnostic path becomes an argument
        instead of a fix.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - design-review
          - evaluation
          - domain-analysis
          - statistical-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:bms
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Review appraiser sign-off before the value is reported
      summary: Pause for the review appraiser; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable
      summary: Return the completed Valuation + independent re-derivation deliverable, the evidence behind
        it, and every unresolved item.
  edges:
    - id: wf-rec-01-edge-1
      from: n-intake
      to: n-select
      kind: data
    - id: wf-rec-01-edge-2
      from: n-select
      to: n-derive
      kind: data
    - id: wf-rec-01-edge-3
      from: n-select
      to: n-recompute
      kind: data
    - id: wf-rec-01-edge-4
      from: n-derive
      to: n-agree
      kind: data
    - id: wf-rec-01-edge-5
      from: n-recompute
      to: n-agree
      kind: data
    - id: wf-rec-01-edge-6
      from: n-agree
      to: n-discrepancy
      kind: data
    - id: wf-rec-01-edge-7
      from: n-discrepancy
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: agreed
    - id: wf-rec-01-edge-8
      from: n-discrepancy
      to: n-reconcile
      kind: control
      condition: discrepant
    - id: wf-rec-01-edge-9
      from: n-reconcile
      to: n-approval
      kind: data
    - id: wf-rec-01-edge-10
      from: n-approval
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
